headword: {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}

definitions.explanation: The science and practice of protecting and improving the health of communities through disease prevention, health education, sanitation, and policy measures.

examples.japanese: {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}の{改善|かいぜん}は{重要|じゅうよう}な{課題|かだい}だ。
examples.english: Improving public health is an important issue.

examples.japanese: {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}の{専門家|せんもんか}が{感染症対策|かんせんしょうたいさく}について{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: A public health expert explained measures against infectious diseases.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}の{日本|にほん}では、{公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}の{向上|こうじょう}が{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}の{延|の}びに{大|おお}きく{貢献|こうけん}した。
examples.english: In postwar Japan, improvements in public health greatly contributed to the increase in average life expectancy.

notes:
USAGE:
A Sino-Japanese compound: {公衆|こうしゅう} (public, the general public) + {衛生|えいせい} (hygiene, sanitation). Commonly encountered in news about health crises, government health policy, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}{上|じょう}の{問題|もんだい} (a public health concern)
- {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}の{専門家|せんもんか} (public health expert)
- {公衆衛生|こうしゅうえいせい}{政策|せいさく} (public health policy)

RELATED WORDS:
- {衛生|えいせい}: hygiene, sanitation
- {保健|ほけん}: health care, health maintenance
- {予防医学|よぼういがく}: preventive medicine
